title: Buying Mountain Land in NC: What to Check First
excerpt: Mountain land in the High Country of NC can be one of the most rewarding purchases you ever make — but only if you know what to check before you sign. Local REALTOR Andrew Plyler walks you through the essential due diligence steps that protect your investment and your peace of mind.
